Lemma
[Loops decompose over a path-connected open cover]

↗ def:loop-and-pi1-set

1. ch1:1.15\group Fundamental Group

If $X=\bigcup _\alpha A_\alpha $, each $A_\alpha $ is path-connected and open, contains $x_0$, and every pairwise intersection is path-connected, then every loop at $x_0$ is homotopic to a product of loops each contained in one $A_\alpha $.

Proof

\sketch Subdivide the parameter interval so each subpath lies in one cover set. At each subdivision point choose a path in the adjacent intersection from $x_0$ to that point, and insert that path and its inverse. The resulting factors are loops in individual cover sets.

□
